items.text: This update focuses on improving how the game is packaged and delivered to your system.

[p align="start"]Previously, the game used a less optimized file structure, which could lead to larger install sizes and less efficient loading. The game has now been fully rebuilt using a more optimized system that organizes data in a faster and more efficient way.
[p align="start"][img src="https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/17.0/1f4e6/72.png"] Game size reduced from 42 GB → 23.7 GB (~44% smaller).
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"] [img src="https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/17.0/1f680/72.png"] Faster loading times when starting the game and switching areas
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/17.0/1f3af/72.png"] Smoother asset streaming (fewer hiccups during gameplay)
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"] [img src="https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/17.0/1f4be/72.png"] More efficient disk access (especially noticeable on slower drives)
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"] [img src="https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/17.0/1f9e0/72.png"] Improved memory usage
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"] [img src="https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/17.0/1f6e0_fe0f/72.png"] Improved overall stability and build reliability
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"] [img src="https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/17.0/1f41e/72.png"] Fixed a few critical bugs
The demo has being updated as well.
[p align="start"]In simple terms, the game now reads data in a more organized and optimized way, reducing loading delays and improving overall performance.
[p align="start"]This update doesn’t change gameplay, but it should make the experience feel smoother and more polished.
[p align="start"]If you notice improvements (or anything unexpected), feel free to share your feedback — it really helps.
[p align="start"]Thanks for playing!

As a small Christmas gift to players—and a way to better showcase the game—this new demo has been fully updated to reflect the current Steam version, replacing the previous demo.

[p align="start"]🎄 A Festive Way to Experience Albatroz

[p align="start"]This updated demo is designed to be a more engaging introduction to Albatroz, giving players more content, smoother gameplay, and continuity with the full game—all just in time for the holidays.
We’ll have some exciting news to share in 2026 — thank you all for making this such a great year.

releases.displayName: The Free Roam Mode Update: Discover Albatroz Your Way!

items.text: We’re excited to introduce one of the most requested features from the community: Free Roam Mode!
This new mode is designed for those who want to focus on exploration and story without the pressure of survival mechanics.

A huge thank you to everyone who asked for this — and especially to MySoulToTake, who not only shared valuable feedback but also reminded us of a critical issue just minutes before release (you saved the day!)
Other than that, we’re also releasing more fixes, optimizations, and polish, as usual.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560387/1606e248c147e2b88750fb47d69b3f0c99ead9fd.png"]
The idea behind this mode is to let you focus on exploration without the RPG mechanics getting in the way.

notes.title: Free Roam is perfect for those who want to

items.text: Explore at their own pace
Focus on the narrative
Discover the path to Albatroz
Hunt for hidden places
You’ll lose no stats from exploring (feet, arms, hunger and thirsty).
Temperature has little to no effect.
Car fuel consumption and car damage are minimal.
Buff items last much longer before wearing off.
Skills cooldown are minimum
Arm stats are still consumed normally.
World damage still applies — meaning if a rock falls on your head, a strong wind strikes you, an enemy attacks, or you fall from a high place, you’ll still lose health as usual.
You can switch to Free Roam at the beginning of the game (right after starting your journey) or at any time through the configuration menu.
Reduced global VRAM usage by ~150 MB ( A hurray for 8 GB GPUs )
Fixed distance shader: buildings and mountains no longer appear overly dark from afar.
Post-credits log: The maximum number of regions and clues is now displayed correctly, making it possible to track exactly what’s missing.
Scene 19 (Serpi/Yotsaken event): Resolved an issue where players were not being teleported back to Isla after the conversation..
Environment: Removed a rock blocking the middle of a bridge in the last city (seriously, how did nobody report that until now? ).
Scene 18 (car chase): fixed collision issues causing the car to float.
Scene 19: fixed disappearing ground bug that made players fall through the world.
Various minor fixes and optimizations across the game.
Once more thank you very much MySoulToTake, hope you have fun with the free roam!
Enjoy Alba in Free Roam Mode, and as always, if you don't like anything, or like it, please let us know.
Cheers!

Hello, everyone!

We’re excited to announce that Patch #13 for Albatroz is now live on Steam! This update smooths the path for your journey through The Forbidden Lands, with a reworked save/load system, refined gameplay, and various fixes to keep your adventure on course.
Thank you for your continued support! We hope you enjoy the update, and don’t worry—there’s more on the way. Don't forget to check the patch notes below for all the details.
Post-Credits Scene: Fixed an issue where the maximum number of clues was not displaying correctly.
Save/Load System: Fixed missing game image and text when the save file’s region or location couldn't be found.
Save Slot Improvements: Added default textures and names for save slots with unidentified area IDs (previously displayed as "None" with a blank texture).
Character Issues:
Isla no longer disappears when pressing the "V" key during conversations with NPCs.
Fixed an issue where Isla's backpack was missing after completing the distortion and returning to Lago Village.
Map & UI Fixes:
Added missing map legends.
Fixed unnecessary 'Confirm' and 'Cancel' buttons appearing in certain settings within the configuration menu.
Environmental Fixes:
Fixed missing textures and collisions on stones in the snowy region.
Resolved collision issues with rocks while climbing in Last Village.
Fixed missing collision behind the hotel in El Condor.
Fixed floating rocks seen when descending the Grand Wall.
Addressed back-face culling issues and visible rock edges in Scene 17 – Sence Adventure.
Resolved clipping issues when climbing the mountain near the giant tree.
Fixed levitating rock while traveling towards the Sacred Place in Scene 08.
The camp's bed no longer clips into the mountain when placed on Crying Mountain Trail.
Gameplay Fixes:
The player no longer gets stuck after jumping on Romero's brother's head in El Condor Village.
Fixed a softlock where the game would freeze if the player pressed "Switch Party Member" after reaching the village in Scene 1.
End Credits: Fixed multiple errors.
General Fixes & Polishing:
Fixed various corrupted collisions throughout the game.
Minor bug fixes, polish, and overall adjustments.
Small optimizations
Save/Load System: Re-worked on the save and load interface to improve usability and overall design to look better.
-Among Giants & SOEDESCO
Hey, everyone!
We’re happy to let you know that Albatroz Patch V12 has landed on Steam! This update brings fresh improvements and critical fixes to ensure your adventures are as enjoyable as possible.
As always, we appreciate your support. Don’t forget to check out the full patch notes below for all the details, and keep an eye out for more updates coming soon!

Improved performance in salt desert and in the mountains using HLODs on the rocks: This is a significant optimization. HLODs (Hierarchical Level of Detail) reduce the number of polygons rendered for distant objects, improving frame rates, especially in graphically demanding environments like deserts and mountains.
New path on scene 15 so the player has more options to complete the level.
Fixed corrupted collision on scene 14, going down the hole: This addresses a gameplay-blocking bug where players might get stuck or fall through the world due to incorrect collision.
Fixed a death dialogue that was wrong in scene 14: Corrects an error in the game's dialogue related to player death in this specific scene.
Fixed the death trigger in scene 15 to kill the player if he falls from the world: Prevents players from exploiting falling out of the map and ensures a proper game over.
Fixed gaps on scene 15, on the nameless realm where the player could fall in the world: Patches holes in the game world geometry, preventing unintended falls and softlocks.
Added a new path on scene 15 so the player has more options to complete the level: Improves level design by offering alternative routes, enhancing replayability and player choice.
Fixed some broken shaders in scene 15: Corrects visual glitches related to how materials are rendered in this scene.
Fixed some localization issues: Addresses errors in translated text, improving the experience for players using different languages.

Fixed missing picture issue on the loading/saving game page, when the game was not able to find the region the player is: Corrects a visual bug on the save/load screen when the game couldn't determine the player's location.

Fixed a missing name on the loading and saving game page when the game was not able to find where the player is: Addresses a similar issue to the above, but related to missing text instead of a picture.

Fixed an issue that the load and save page would return invalid, if just Isla was in the party: Fixes a specific bug that caused save/load issues when the player's party consisted only of the character "Isla."
Hello, everyone!

We're thrilled to announce that Albatroz Patch 11 is now live on Steam! This update follows our recent content pack release and introduces exciting improvements and fixes to issues blocking your adventures.

In this update, Scene 15 has been improved, providing players with more options to escape the Realm of the Nameless. Additionally, we've resolved some rare issues, including the black screen that appeared after death and fixes for the moving platform that frequently failed to operate. Alongside these changes, we've made various minor fixes for a smoother overall experience.
Once again, thank you for your continued support! Stay tuned for more updates across all platforms, and check the patch notes below for all the details.

Fixed Black Screen After Death: Fixed a rare issue where the screen would sometimes turn black after death and not fade out properly. The transition now works as expected, providing a smoother experience.

Improved Scene 15 (Distortions): Added new paths and options in Scene 15, giving players more ways to escape the Realm of the Nameless. These changes enhance the scene's replayability and strategic choices.
Fixed Progression Issue in Scene 15: Fixed an issue where players could die and still continue playing. Now, death correctly resets progression to ensure proper gameplay flow.
Fixed Moving Platform Issue in Scene 15: Addressed a rare bug where a moving platform would sometimes fail to move. Players can now use alternative paths if the platform doesn’t function as expected.
Fixed Initial Tutorial: Corrected an issue with the game's initial tutorial that caused confusion. The controls and mechanics are now explained more clearly.
Other Minor Fixes and Polish: Various minor fixes and improvements across the game, including performance optimizations and interface tweaks for a smoother experience
-Among Giants & SOEDESCO

Optimizations to reduce stutters (small, sudden pauses) and frame drops related to collision when activating triggers. These improvements have been applied across scenes 1 to 20 to make gameplay smoother and reduce interruptions.
If you experience any stutters or frame drops elsewhere in the game, please let us know, and we’ll work to address them.
